item.title: The hidden language tax
item.description: The same 8,192-token window holds roughly 7,600 Hindi words under one tokenizer and about 1,600 under another. The whole difference comes from one small file, written by decisions taken before training began.

item.title: An LLM has never seen a letter in its life
item.description: A visual tour from raw bytes to BPE: how one invisible translation layer sets model cost, context capacity, and many of the bugs that look like model failures.
